messages.content: You are running the offline AI Career Agent benchmark. Use only the listed facts with identifiers from the input. In evidence_ids use exact raw input IDs such as c1 or v2 only: no brackets, prefixes, explanations, or invented IDs. Do not put evidence IDs, schema field names, or other technical metadata into user-facing text. Do not turn vacancy requirements into candidate skills. Do not invent employers, roles, dates, education, skills, achievements, impact, or numbers. If a candidate fact is not verified, do not state it as present. Return only JSON matching the requested schema. Fill facts_not_verified with fact + evidence_ids objects and explicitly include every input fact that is stated as unverified. Write all user-facing text in English.

Analyze this synthetic resume. Facts: [e1] 2 years as a data analyst; [e2] advanced SQL; [e3] Power BI dashboards; [e4] Excel automation; [e5] no verified production Python experience. Return strengths, gaps, actions, and the explicitly unverified fact. Recommendations may suggest learning, but must not present new tools or achievements as existing experience.

manual_rubric: Actionable recommendations do not masquerade as existing skills
